operating_rules: Tooltips must be enabled in Photoshop settings (Edit > Preferences > Notifications on Windows; Photoshop > Settings > Notifications on Mac) to see credit cost warnings when hovering over generate actions
Always create new layer before using remove tool to work non-destructively and enable sampling from layers beneath
Patch tool requires working on layer with existing pixels (not empty layer); use Ctrl/Cmd+J to duplicate before patching
Sticky shortcuts: hold secondary tool shortcut momentarily while primary tool selected (e.g. hold R for rotate while using brush, then release to return to brush)
Cycle similar tools via Shift + group shortcut (e.g. Shift+J cycles remove/healing/patch tools)
Remove tool generative AI currently does NOT consume credits (as of video recording date), but this may change
For complex selections that auto-detection misses, combine object selection tool with lasso tool for manual refinement
